evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Distinct search mechanism (fingerprinting) not substantially contained in other search/recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based search is a different requirement from fingerprinting, similar-users search, or recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Similar-users based search differs from profile-based search and from recommendation delivery (e.g., ZO-010).

evaluations.evidence: discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Video-seeded content-similarity discovery is not the same requirement as general music search or image-seeded video recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata/tag-driven discovery is distinct from fingerprinting, profile/similar-user approaches, and admin prefiltering by metadata.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Tag persistence across processing is not duplicated by other stories that use tags for search/prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: UI requirement to view thumbnails is distinct from segmentation editing/validation and similarity info retrieval.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Substantially overlaps with ZO-009, which also requests info about similar video items and segments; 'perceptually' does not create a meaningful separate requirement here.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates ZO-008's requirement to get info about similar video items/segments; 'perceptually similar' appears to be the same similarity concept without a distinct actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation delivery based on similar profiles is distinct from search-based discovery stories (ZO-002/ZO-003).

evaluations.evidence: recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Location/news-event-driven recommendations are not expressed elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information
evaluations.rationale: Person identification is a distinct entity type compared to products/logos/brands.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information
evaluations.rationale: Product identification differs meaningfully from persons/logos/brands identification requirements.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster-logo identification is a distinct target compared to products/persons/brands.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is distinct from products and broadcaster logos as separate recognition targets.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Image-seeded video recommendation is not duplicated by other recommendation/search stories.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Map-based exploration/notification is distinct from other recommendation and search mechanisms.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a distinct search modality not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation validation/editing differs from segment annotation/topic extraction (ZO-020).

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Topic extraction/annotation is distinct from segmentation editing (ZO-019).

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: A/V quality filtering/ranking is not duplicated by other prefiltering stories focused on nudity, metadata, or low-level asset info.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Audio-edit detection is distinct from noise removal (ZO-046) and other content filters.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is a specific business rule distinct from other prefiltering approaches.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset info prefiltering is distinct from high-level metadata/tag prefiltering (ZO-026).

evaluations.evidence: validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright infringement validation is not duplicated by other prefiltering/quality checks.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter ... using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag prefiltering differs from low-level asset prefiltering (ZO-024) and from user discovery via metadata (ZO-005) due to actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is
evaluations.rationale: Image interestingness/appeal assessment is distinct from prompting scientists (ZO-028) and other classification/prefiltering tasks.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject
evaluations.rationale: Scientist-prompt detection is a different goal from assessing interestingness (ZO-027) even if inputs overlap.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-type identification is not duplicated by other volunteer-related interruption/education decision stories.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo-specific preclassification is distinct from other domain-specific preclassification/prefiltering stories.

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Empty/none-animal detection is distinct from species/attribute/number preclassification in the same domain.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection ... timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Series detection for timestamp malfunction is a distinct requirement from animal detection/classification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification differs from attribute preclassification (ZO-034) and number detection (ZO-035).

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification is distinct from species preclassification and number detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals is a distinct goal from species/attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation/localization differs from detecting empty images (ZO-037) and from size/orientation/species detection.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: No-plankton detection is distinct from segmentation and species/size/orientation tasks.

evaluations.evidence: detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is distinct from species preclassification (ZO-039) and segmentation/localization (ZO-036).

evaluations.evidence: preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is distinct from size/orientation detection and segmentation/localization.

evaluations.evidence: worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Motion analysis for duration reduction is distinct from detecting egg-laying time (ZO-041).

evaluations.evidence: detect the time ... where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Egg-laying event detection is distinct from general motion analysis for trimming (ZO-040).

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads
evaluations.rationale: Disaster-feature detection in satellite images is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Weighting classifications by experience is distinct from identifying volunteer types (ZO-029) and interruption/education decisions.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal is distinct from detecting moving/transient objects (ZO-045).

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is distinct from artefact removal (ZO-044).

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Noise removal is distinct from whale-call grouping/counting and from detecting prior audio editing (ZO-022).

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Grouping similar calls differs from counting whales in a file (ZO-048).

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales is distinct from grouping similar calls (ZO-047).

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing decision for interruption is distinct from choosing interruption modality (ZO-050).

evaluations.evidence: whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Modality selection is distinct from the decision of when to interrupt (ZO-049).

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing decision for education is distinct from choosing education modality/content (ZO-052/ZO-053).

evaluations.evidence: whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Education modality selection is distinct from when to educate (ZO-051) and which education piece (ZO-053).

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selecting specific educational content differs from deciding timing (ZO-051) or modality (ZO-052).

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting volunteer comments is distinct from deciding when Zoonibot should comment/explain.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Bot-comment timing is distinct from bot-explanation timing (ZO-056) and bot message content (ZO-057).

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Bot-explanation timing is distinct from bot-comment timing (ZO-055) and deciding what to say (ZO-057).

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Message content selection is distinct from timing decisions for commenting/explaining (ZO-055/ZO-056).

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Subject similarity grouping is not duplicated elsewhere (video similarity info stories concern video items/segments).

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation to volunteers is distinct from content recommendation stories aimed at users (ZO-010/ZO-011/ZO-016).

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization for reuse is not expressed elsewhere in the backlog.
